scope: 100 directly inspected vanilla texture resource IDs (57 R9 + 43 R11; includes identical-byte aliases and layer assets). Exact SHA-256 comparator index, not an automated art grade.

vertical_bark.principle: Unequal vertical ridges, interrupted secondary clusters, coherent turning planes.
vertical_bark.limit: Exact high-quality palette variants may share geometry.

horizontal_bark.principle: Broad planes or horizontal lenticels/streaks; distinguish species.
horizontal_bark.limit: Do not force vertical grain onto birch or jungle.

growth_rings.principle: Ring offsets and local close shades; bark boundary has texture.
growth_rings.limit: Shared ring geometry is legitimate when material supports it.

needles.principle: Thin directed needle groups and structure-driven cutouts.
needles.limit: Tiny components and intentional diagonals are valid.

broadleaf.principle: Leaf groups with local depth and structured transparent openings.
broadleaf.limit: Raw grayscale may be tinted; four colors can suffice.

ground_aggregates.principle: Material-specific aggregate size, irregular local relationships; inspect tiling.
ground_aggregates.limit: Sand is finer, gravel more angular, moss denser; no forced noise or palette quota.

stone_surface.principle: Coherent rock structure, differentiated rock edges, subdued base variations.
stone_surface.limit: Stone can use four colors; deepslate may be directional and cobble deliberately clustered.

mineral_inclusions.principle: Keep recognizable host rock; inclusions embedded with meaningful local light.
mineral_inclusions.limit: No forced round spots or universal palette size.

clothing.principle: Read silhouette, folds, material-specific edge shading.
clothing.limit: Inventory icon is not worn UV; wool block does not specify a clothing silhouette.

saplings.principle: Species silhouette and attached foliage follow branch hierarchy.
saplings.limit: Do not just recolor a crown.

glass_vessel.principle: Neck/shoulder/body, purposefully empty interior, cool edge highlights.
glass_vessel.limit: Cutout glass may have no partial alpha; inspect intended rendering separately.

metal_vessel.principle: Distinct opening, rim, turning surface and local metal highlights.
metal_vessel.limit: Do not copy a bucket silhouette blindly; metal and clay should not share generic shine.

clay_vessel.principle: Matte light planes, mouth and base, warm restrained transition.
clay_vessel.limit: Brick and terracotta are material references, not vessel construction references.

leather_vessel.principle: Soft contour with folds or seam where function calls for it.
leather_vessel.limit: Leather hide is material reference; do not copy it as pouch geometry.

wood_vessel.principle: Dark cavity and rim with grain aligned to construction.
wood_vessel.limit: Plank repeat is not a cup silhouette.

metal_ingot.principle: Top and side planes, coherent sharp local highlights.
metal_ingot.limit: Similar silhouettes may differ by surface light response.

fired_clay.principle: Warm matte planes, edges and mortar when relevant.
fired_clay.limit: Terracotta is intentionally subdued; no mandatory bright microcontrast.

leather_material.principle: Broad warm inner planes and restrained folds/edges.
leather_material.limit: Grayscale armor tint is a separate rendering concern.

food.principle: Material-specific crust, flesh or skin shapes and highlights.
food.limit: Don't apply shiny fruit shading to bread.

wood_planks.principle: Plank joints, small horizontal grain clusters, repeated construction rhythm.
wood_planks.limit: Palette variants share exact structure; repetition is intended.

textile.principle: Low local contrast, dense small soft clusters give woven/fibrous impression.
textile.limit: White wool has 40 RGB colors; red wool 36. No numeric palette ceiling.

cold_surface.principle: Snow soft near-white clusters; ice translucent streaks.
cold_surface.limit: Snow three colors; ice all pixels partially transparent, renderer context matters.

glass_surface.principle: Edge reflections or translucent volume as appropriate.
glass_surface.limit: Empty cutout vs partial alpha are distinct material treatments.

metal_surface.principle: Coherent rims and oriented highlights, relatively broad smooth planes.
metal_surface.limit: Iron has horizontal streaks; gold and copper diagonal reflections.

copper_oxidation.principle: Preserve metal construction while changing copper/patina regions through stages.
copper_oxidation.limit: Full oxide block does not prescribe patina placement on a vessel.

tools.principle: Separate handle and working part with distinct ramps; use functional silhouette.
tools.limit: Shared tool geometry can support progression; don't obscure the working edge.

paper.principle: Light broad plane, shaded stepped edges, restrained interior.
paper.limit: A quiet interior is valid; no arbitrary marks to increase detail.

charcoal.principle: Dark, irregular fragment silhouette with warm-dark edge changes.
charcoal.limit: A lump is not a filter mechanism; use function-specific shape.

axe_icon.principle: Distinct broad cutting head, socket and diagonal handle. Use separate head and handle ramps, face/bevel contrasts and recognizable silhouette.
axe_icon.limit: All three use 60 visible pixels; material variants can preserve construction.

pickaxe_icon.principle: Read the arched narrow working head and open space below it; maintain handle/head joint and edge lighting.
pickaxe_icon.limit: Do not turn the working head into a solid axe or add noise to a thin blade.

sword_icon.principle: Blade, point, crossguard, grip and pommel read separately; lengthwise edge ramp defines blade.
sword_icon.limit: Different materials can share silhouette; compare cutting edge and material response.

hoe_icon.principle: Short bent working end with open negative space and long handle; keep geometry distinct from pickaxe.
hoe_icon.limit: Only 51 visible pixels in these references; do not thicken to fill the canvas.

shovel_icon.principle: Compact broad spade head, central face and shaded edge, socket and handle.
shovel_icon.limit: 53 visible pixels in both; preserve the shovel silhouette.

utility_tool_icon.principle: Recognizable two-part mechanism, localized metal highlights and functional gaps.
utility_tool_icon.limit: No universal diagonal tool geometry for shears, ignition tools or custom devices.

bow_states.principle: Preserve wood, string, arrow and hand anchor across states; progressively deform bow/string as tension changes.
bow_states.limit: Model overrides select states in 1.21.1; not a timed texture strip.

rod_states.principle: Preserve rod, grip and material; distinguish actual cast state by line/hook silhouette.
rod_states.limit: Do not move whole sprite or change anchor when only the state changes.

consumable_icon.principle: Show edible material or contained liquid by recognizable shape, localized shading and readable container boundaries.
consumable_icon.limit: Potion raw base aliases glass_bottle; actual tint/layers require model and renderer inspection.

armor_metal_icon.principle: Recognizable slot silhouette and dark contour, shaped collar/plates/boot toes, localized metal edge and broader faces; material-specific highlight.
armor_metal_icon.limit: Do not use icon as worn UV; netherite uses subdued dark ramps and shared chestplate shape can be legitimate.

armor_soft_icon.principle: Soft construction, folds, opening and dyed base with readable outline; compare the composite rather than raw grayscale.
armor_soft_icon.limit: Layer tint and actual overlay are part of the final icon, not evidence of absent color.

armor_chain_icon.principle: Use alternating restrained gray clusters to suggest mail links while retaining solid recognizable chestplate shape.
armor_chain_icon.limit: Inventory icon is not the literal transparent chainmail UV mask.

armor_icon_overlay.principle: Review actual composed icon and registered tint/layer behavior; maintain exact alignment with base.
armor_icon_overlay.limit: The inspected vanilla chestplate overlay is entirely transparent. An intentional empty overlay is not automatically a missing icon.

armor_metal_uv.principle: Paint for the actual body-part UV faces; local plate edges and shading follow cuboid orientation, maintain slot boundaries and material across seams.
armor_metal_uv.limit: 64x32 is the standard humanoid atlas for these samples, not a universal custom armor canvas. Inspect both layers and equipped model.

armor_leather_uv.principle: Use dyed soft panels and seams/straps in aligned non-dyed overlays; preserve UV face boundaries and appropriate coverage.
armor_leather_uv.limit: Sparse overlay and transparent unused regions are intentional; assess combined equipped material, not fill percentage.

armor_chain_uv.principle: Use transparent cutouts and related metal link clusters along actual UV regions; check seams and player skin visibility.
armor_chain_uv.limit: Periodic cutout motifs are appropriate mail construction, unlike unrelated mechanical ground repetition.

r11_items.scope: Item/armor extension; original r9 record revision remains compatible. Newly inspected archive PNGs independently verified by official-client research CI.
